comparison.pairing: control and candidate share suite, question ids, mapping, model, judges, budgets and scoring rules

models.restriction: the current user restriction permits free OpenRouter models only for later live work

physicalCallEstimate.note: measured on the frozen preset-r1 baseline; labelInjections off, so no injection-label calls

campaign.physicalCallRule: stop before exceeding the cap; an incomplete run is reported incomplete, never silently completed
campaign.wallTimeNote: LongMemEval-M ingest dominates wall time; it is measured, never assumed zero

cost.note: both answerer and judges are OpenRouter :free routes; quotas and caps, not USD, bind execution

candidateGap.neededRounds: repaired fine-gold round ids (causalSessions -> sessionRounds -> extractEvidence.fineGoldIds)
candidateGap.numerator: questions whose needed round set has no member returned in any successful memory.recall hit or memory.read note on the selected answer attempt
candidateGap.denominator: paired questions carrying >=1 mapped needed round in both roles with complete retained tool traces in both roles
candidateGap.evidenceSource: successful tool results only; hidden candidates, rankings, passive injection, recalledIds and progress logs never count
candidateGap.failures: answer run-limit/transport/setup failures count as not-surfaced in the worst-case bound and are excluded from the primary estimate; never zero
candidateGap.missingness: no fine-round labels or an unresolved gold reference are unmeasurable by suite and excluded from every estimate; never zero
candidateGap.zeroGapBaseline: control gap 0 requires candidate gap 0 on the same paired questions; no halving claim, pass only on exact no-loss
candidateGap.halving: positive control gap requires candidateGap <= 0.5 * controlGap
candidateGap.pooled: per-suite rows are the claim; a pooled-only verdict is not a pass
candidateGap.uncertainty: 10000 whole-conversation cluster bootstrap draws on paired gap differences with two-sided cluster sign-flip p; reported, not substituted for the frozen rules
candidateGap.inconclusive: too few complete pairs to distinguish, or the worst-case bound fails while the best-case bound passes

abilityGuard.metric: frozen binary correctness from the two-judge panel
abilityGuard.rule: every suite x ability stratum must satisfy candidate - control >= -0.03 on the observed paired accuracy
abilityGuard.uncertainty: exact paired cluster sign-flip p and cluster-bootstrap CI reported; the veto is the frozen margin, not the p-value
abilityGuard.multiplicity: Holm across each suite's ability strata for description only; strata are underpowered and no equivalence claim follows
abilityGuard.missing: a stratum with no comparable pairs is reported as unverified and blocks closure

paired.pairing: unique question ids, frozen conversation clusters and abilities

analysis.pairing: unique question ids, matching conversation clusters and abilities; incomplete comparisons have no gap
analysis.screening: item-weighted paired mean; 10000 whole-cluster bootstrap draws; two-sided cluster sign-flips; seed 7
analysis.multiplicity: Holm across all emitted overall, ability-binary and ability-graded tests in one baseline summary; pointwise CIs; descriptive only

acceptance.multiplicity: BFC is a conjunction: every required suite/model NI row and superiority row must pass its frozen bound; no selectable-row claims. Any subset claim needs prospective multiplicity registration.
acceptance.warning: Sizing is conditional on discordance and within-conversation paired-difference ICC; not an acceptance verdict. Normal approximation is optimistic with few clusters.

analysis.resumption: not authorized; Task 4.7 pilot and Task 4.8 readiness must freeze current models, judges, limits, product and this protocol

evidenceProtocol.traceRetention: answer/query/tool-result/excerpt retention with retry evidence reset

isolation.note: control and candidate never share answer checkpoints, judge caches, stores or logs; enrichment cannot leak into the control

baselineReuse.reason: Task 5.1 established that no historical revision-1 run retained compatible tool-result traces; the owner-closed 23-cell screen stays immutable
